titulo.alumno: Integrated A1 review: personal information and immediate needs

intro: In this lesson you will practice integrated A1 review: personal information and immediate needs.

frases.alumno: What word do we learn today?

frases.estudio: Συνήθως ξυπνώ στις επτά, δουλεύω το πρωί και μαγειρεύω το βράδυ.
frases.alumno: I usually wake up at seven, work in the morning and cook at night.

frases.estudio: Με λένε Άννα. Είμαι από τη Θεσσαλονίκη και μαθαίνω ελληνικά.
frases.alumno: My name is Anna. I'm from Thessaloniki and I'm learning Greek.

frases.estudio: Αγαπητή Μαρία, είμαι καλά. Σήμερα έχει ήλιο και περπατώ στο κέντρο.
frases.alumno: Dear Maria: I'm fine. It's sunny today and I'm walking around the center.

texto: Combine an introduction, personal details and a simple request in a short exchange.

pregunta.texto: Listen to the introduction and recognize which personal information is shared.
